entries.claim_boundary: This LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC + REDUCED-MODE theorem derives the generic-ell axial Schwarzschild Ricci-carrier and homogeneous metric asymptotic systems, all-orders formal recurrence pivots, compatible integer-spaced resonances and exact exceptional set. It computes no literal Lee-Wald current, finite-pairing selection, polar sector, asymptotic phase space, Hilbert norm, scattering, QNM, stability, particle, positivity or quantum result.

dispersion.statement: The exact EF exponential rates are 0 and -2 i omega; carrier powers are {0,-1} and {-4 i M omega,-4 i M omega-1}, while the metric-master powers are -3 and 1-4 i M omega.

lee_wald.statement: The generic-ell recurrence is ready for the separately gated literal-current calculation; no current coefficient or finite-pairing theorem is asserted here.

resonance.statement: The n=1 integer-spaced resonance in each top carrier sector is exactly compatible and introduces no logarithm; all later pivots are nonzero for real omega != 0.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: No nonlinear or second-order solution is evaluated.

causal_retarded.statement: No retarded propagator or causal phase space is constructed.

taub_maps.statement: No compact second-order Taub map is involved.
